target_customer: Crypto wallets, exchanges and dapps that need NFT and token data across chains
problem: Developers had to integrate and maintain separate indexers per blockchain to get token and NFT data.
product_category: Multi-chain token and NFT data API

founders.name: Olly Wilson
founders.background_notes: No bio on the YC page.

founders.name: Alex Kilkka
founders.background_notes: Described as building NFT infrastructure; listed as acquired by Phantom.

exit.reason: Phantom wallet acquired the team and technology to power its token data; the public API shut down on 27 March 2025.

competitors.name: Alchemy
competitors.what: Blockchain developer platform with an NFT API, launched 2020
competitors.traction_then: described as one of the largest Web3 API providers

competitors.name: Moralis
competitors.what: Web3 backend and NFT API provider

technical_complexity.rationale: Indexing many chains with edge cases and high request volume is demanding infrastructure work, but built on known techniques.

defensibility.rationale: Customers integrated the API and breadth across chains was costly to match, but Alchemy and Moralis competed directly and the NFT market was cyclical.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbent API providers stayed in market; Phantom, a wallet customer, bought SimpleHash in February 2025.

market_need_then: The 2021 NFT boom and rapid growth of new chains created demand from wallets and marketplaces for unified token data.

brand_strength.rationale: Recognized among crypto developers and listed as a provider for Coinbase, Phantom and Uniswap, but no sign of consumer or community brand pull.

outcome_analysis: SimpleHash won blue chip crypto customers such as Coinbase, Phantom and Uniswap with a multi-chain data API and was acquired by Phantom in February 2025, after which the public API was shut down. The exit looks like a strategic acquisition of a lean, well used infrastructure product.
notes: Funding: aggregators list a 125K seed in March 2022 and a 500K total; single aggregator figures, unverified and not recorded as rounds. The simplehash.com homepage returned HTTP 503. Founding year on YC page is 2022 while batch is Winter 2022. Acquisition date varies slightly across outlets (25 to 27 Feb 2025). Competitor traction details are from a competitor's own blog and are marketing leaning. Founder backgrounds were not found. Update: a 125K seed of March 2022 is recorded from aggregator data (Seedtable); VCBacked and Seedtable also show a pre-seed dated April 2023. The Block states SimpleHash raised 500K in total from investors including Y Combinator and Coinbase Ventures, so rounds are incomplete and the gap is recorded here. Not independently verified.
